#OhGeesy Spreads Love On Thanksgiving By Giving Back To The Community And Showing Support To Those In Need 🙏🏼🦃❤️💯 @ohgeesy 

OhGeesy, born Alejandro Coranza, is a Mexican-American rapper, entrepreneur, and founding member of the legendary Los Angeles rap group Shoreline Mafia. Emerging from the underground LA rap scene, OhGeesy helped introduce a new generation of West Coast hip-hop to the mainstream with viral hits like “Musty,” “Nun Major,” “Bands,” and “Bottle Service.”

Following Shoreline Mafia’s initial split in 2020, OhGeesy launched a successful solo career, releasing projects like GEEZYWORLD and GEEZYWORLD 2. His signature flow, infectious hooks, and authentic California sound have earned him millions of streams, a loyal fanbase, and collaborations with some of the biggest names in hip-hop, including DaBaby, Central Cee, and Tyga.

From performing at small clubs to headlining major arenas, OhGeesy has taken his career to another level. His recent performances at Viejas Arena in San Diego and alongside Shoreline Mafia at the SAP Center in San Jose highlight the growing demand for West Coast music and the movement he helped build.

Beyond music, OhGeesy has become an influential figure in streetwear, fashion, sneaker culture, and Los Angeles nightlife. He’s also known for showing love to his fans, supporting emerging artists, and giving back to his community.

From the underground streets of Los Angeles to performing in front of thousands of fans, OhGeesy’s journey continues to represent the evolution of West Coast hip-hop, Mexican-American representation, and California rap culture on a global stage. 🌎📈🔥
